<function name="RandomPairs" parent="Global" type="libraryfunc">
	<description>Returns an iterator function that can be used to loop through a table in random order</description>
	<realm>Shared and Menu</realm>
	<file line="614-L634">lua/includes/extensions/table.lua</file>
	<args>
		<arg name="table" type="table">Table to create iterator for</arg>
		<arg name="descending" type="boolean" default="nil">Whether the iterator should iterate descending or not</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="function">Iterator function</ret>
		<ret name="" type="table">Internal iterator state, not the source table. It must be passed straight through to the generic for loop; capturing only the first return value and iterating over that will error.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Creates a table and prints its contents in random order</description>
	<code>
local tab = {"a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f"}

for k, v in RandomPairs(tab) do
    print(v)
end
	</code>
	<output>
b
d
f
c
a
e
	</output>

</example>
